selection: Select one candidate per arm using 2025 validation MAE; refit only on labels available before 2026-01-01. Do not alter the candidate set, cohort, parameters or choice using 2026 scores.
cohort: The same eight stocks and identical eligible company-month rows in both arms. Require full origin and target calendar months, a subsequent observed date for label availability, six previous months and positive prices/volume. Exclude any feature or target interval crossing an unreviewed listed-share change. Verify reviewed cancellation share changes against immutable KRX raw days.
cancellation: 120 calendar day lookback; use only original and correction quantities available from the next KST date after each disclosure. Execution date and later listed-share observation are audit-only.
metric: Paired MAE of next-month mean unadjusted close-price change, percentage points; also report the 0% recent-value baseline and positive-signal sample size.
limitations: 2026 prices and overlapping outcomes were previously inspected in this project. This is a retrospectively scored follow-on period, not an untouched holdout or point-in-time approved dataset. Historical posting times, dividends and complete corporate actions are not reconstructed.
